scope: Native allocation-free PostScript numeric recognition, not EPS execution or rendering

numeric_model.integer: signed32; decimal overflow promotes to real
numeric_model.real: finite IEEE754 f32, standard Rust decimal conversion
numeric_model.radix: unsigned32 base2..36 converted to signed32 bit pattern; overflow refuses
numeric_model.names: complete-word grammar; invalid numeric-looking names remain names

bounds.input: caller configured word-byte limit before scanning
bounds.cancellation: per scanned byte and before/after std numeric conversion; std conversion itself is not interruptible and is bounded by input limit

independent_radix_reference.producer: Python int, explicit unsigned32/signed32 conversion, test-only

limitations: decimal float parser not independently bit-qualified against a PostScript implementation
no throughput or interactive latency claim
